cases.question: ¿Cuántas unidades recibidas hubo por producto en órdenes de compra de marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(poi.quantity_received) AS unidades FROM purchase_order po JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN product p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.issued_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND po.issued_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity_received), 0) AS unidades_recibidas FROM public.purchase_order AS po JOIN public.purchase_order_item AS poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN public.product AS p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.issued_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND po.issued_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY unidades_recibidas DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué facturas de compra activas tienen saldo pendiente en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pi.id AS id, pi.series AS series, pi.number AS number, pi.issued_at AS issued_at, pi.total_amount AS total_amount, (pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0)) AS pending_balance FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi LEFT JOIN public.purchase_payment AS pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.issued_at, pi.total_amount HAVING (pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0)) > 0 LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de egresos de caja en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total FROM cash_movement cm WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50
